en.name: Ubiquiti UniFi Flex Mini Switch
en.shortDescription: Compact 5-port gigabit switch, perfect for extending a UniFi network.
en.description:
## Ubiquiti UniFi Flex Mini

A palm-sized 5-port gigabit switch that extends your network to a desk, TV unit or small cabinet.

- Five auto-sensing Gigabit Ethernet ports
- USB-C powered
- Fanless, silent

so.name: Ubiquiti UniFi Flex Mini Switch
so.shortDescription: Switch 5-dekedood ah oo yar oo gigabit ah, ku habboon kordhinta shabakadda UniFi.
so.description:
## Ubiquiti UniFi Flex Mini

Switch 5-dekedood ah oo cabbirkeedu yar yahay, kordhiya shabakaddaada miiska, TV-ga ama armaajo yar.

- Shan dekedood oo Gigabit Ethernet ah oo otomaatig dareema
- Waxaa lagu shaqaysiiyaa USB-C
- Ma leh fan, aamusan
